insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 39/96 games (41%): 15 picks (7-8) and 24 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Yone against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Yone against them in 41/96 games (43%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Aurora? They go Taliyah
insights.text: Aurora is a G1 favorite (10/37 G1s, played by Clozer). In the 37 later games where it was burned or banned, Clozer went to Taliyah (6/37) and Yone (4/37).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 23 G3+ games, 26/115 picks (23%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 55 champs in G1s, 62 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They get stronger as the series goes deep
